question: After a large overnight gap and directional trading during the event day, does an executable next-open entry earn after-cost profit in the following 2, 5 or 10 sessions?
scope: Frozen portfolio-discovery-v2 stock and ETF revisions. Each evaluation uses a separate CAD or USD 5,000 single-instrument account. SHOP.TO is the named initial case and all usable instruments receive the same 12 rules.

patterns.up_gap_followthrough: Split-consistent opening gap at least threshold, followed by close above open.
patterns.down_gap_reversal: Split-consistent opening gap at most negative threshold, followed by close above open.

execution: Signal at event-day close. Buy next open. Sell after fixed sessions or at fold end. Use the existing whole-share turnover cap, CAD/USD 2 per side, and 30 basis points per side.
evidence: Compare unchanged configurations over the same six historical test folds (2018?2023). Report positive trades, cost-adjusted profit, drawdown, profit excluding the largest 5% of trades, and identical-date passive and SMA200 baselines. An 80% win rate is descriptive. Statistical and independent validation remain required.
